# Security Policy

If you believe you have found a vulnerability in a [KloudKIT](https://kloudkit.com) project,
**please email <info@kloud.email>** or open a private advisory from the repository's
**Security** tab, with a clear description and a proof of concept *(if applicable)*.

Please don't open a public issue for it.
We'll confirm we got your report and keep you posted until it's fixed.

**Kloud Workspace** *(the `workspace` and `ws-*` repositories)* takes its reports as a
[private advisory in ws-meta][], and its full disclosure process is on the
[Security Advisory page][].

[private advisory in ws-meta]: https://github.com/kloudkit/ws-meta/security/advisories/new
[Security Advisory page]: https://ws.kloudkit.com/contribute/security-advisory
